title: refactor(scripts,objectql): codemod-split-engine moves bodies that hand the engine on through a `facade` host port, and computing hand-stub slots; move eight #30020 bodies

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DBD7HivCp9UrtDXykvN12jC)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1YRzpYfqDDnUGmMWK

Refs #30020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — an internal move inside `@objectstack/objectql`; nothing a metadata author writes changes

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 的第四遍(`--members`)学会三条新规则:方法体里的裸 `this` 改读宿主的 `facade` 项(R1),`this[k]` 这类计算键在键都是字面字段名时经宿主读写(R3),`engine.ts` 已导出的名字(`ScopedContext`)从 `./engine.js` 导入(R4);新增第五遍 `--hand-slots`,把手写桩里会计算的宿主槽位搬进它的手写模块(H2)。随后用它把 `ObjectQL` 上八个把引擎本身传出去的方法体搬进各自的 facet,并删掉登记表里对应的八行例外(46 → 38)。这是 #30020 设计 §5 系列的第一个 PR(E1)。
- 为什么改:#30020 要把两个门面类上剩下的例外行换成委托。这八行被 codemod 以 `bare-this` 拒绝。Elon 于 2026-11-06 14:58Z 裁定规则 A:门面仍是唯一的状态持有者,宿主加一个 `facade` 端口,codemod 在逐字节撤销证明下把 `this` 改写为 `this.facade`。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,运行时行为不变。撤销证明仍是逐字节比较,不做任何空白或 import 归一化;两遍各有自己的撤销证明。`.d.ts` 的成员行不变,五个私有方法的 docblock 跟着方法体走,所以共享声明块少了这五段注释。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 的 `identityBodyText` / `identityUndoText`、`literalFieldKeys`、`importsEngineValues`、`runStyles` 和 `generateHandSlots` / `undoHandSlots`;`packages/objectql/src/engine-defaults-and-autonumbers.ts` 的模块头和 import 块。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test` 预期 169 cases in 11 batteries pass;`node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` 预期 38 named exception(s)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`, fourth pass (`--members`), three rules (#30020 design §3):**
  - **R1, the identity port.** A moved body that reads a bare `this` (handing the engine on: `bindHooksToEngine(this, …)`, `new ScopedContext(ctx, this)`) now reads `this.facade`, and the pass adds a `facade: engine` entry to the host interface and its install line. The undo turns `this.facade` back into `this` and drops the entry. `typeof this` in a type position stays as written (`this-type`), since it is a type query, not the value. The first and scoped passes are unchanged and still refuse `bare-this`.
  - **R3, computed field keys.** `this[k]` where every value `k` can take is a literal field name (`readMigrationFlagRowMemoized`'s cache slots) reads and writes those fields through host getters and setters, the same way a named field does.
  - **R4, a name `engine.ts` exports.** `createContext` and `buildHookApi` construct `ScopedContext`, which `engine.ts` exports. The receiving module imports it from `./engine.js` (the cycle is the one the module header already names for values), and the header's import paragraph switches from the types-only sentence to the values one; the undo switches it back. Refused in a routed module.
  - **Hand-grown import lines.** `engine-security-resolvers.ts` carries an import line #30227 grew past the wrap width. `runStyles` reads each statement's form (wrapped or one line) and the move and the undo both keep it, so the proof stays byte for byte.
- **`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`, fifth pass (`--hand-slots STUB`, H2).** A hand-written stub whose host literal carries a slot that computes (an arrow with a body, not a forwarder) has that slot moved into the stub's hand module as `export const SLOT: HOST['SLOT'] = ARROW;`, one indentation level out, so its contextual types are unchanged; the slot becomes the shorthand `SLOT,`. It has its own undo proof, against the tree `--members` left. Used once here: `serveReferenceNames`' `formulaReadsReference` slot moves into `engine-reference-name-visible.ts`.
- **The eight moves** (E1 of the design's §5 series), written by the codemod on the latest `main`:
  - `bindHooks` into `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`;
  - `resolveReadableIdsSecurity` into `engine-security-resolvers.ts`;
  - `buildHookApi` into `engine-defaults-and-autonumbers.ts`;
  - `readMigrationFlagRowMemoized` into `engine-migration-state.ts` (R3);
  - `recomputeSummaries` into `engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts`;
  - `ownershipQueueService` into `engine-insert.ts`;
  - `createContext` into `engine-compatibility-section.ts`;
  - `serveReferenceNames`' slot into `engine-reference-name-visible.ts` (fifth pass).

  The stubs, facet members, host interfaces, host factories and imports are the passes' own output. `engine.ts` goes from 11,153 to 10,977 lines.
- **`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`**: the eight `#30020` rows for these members are removed; `check:facade-delegation-only` is green with 38 named exceptions (46 on `main`).
- **`.changeset/30020-objectql-identity-port-bodies.md`**: `@objectstack/objectql` patch, following #30571 / #30716 (source maps ship).

## Tests

The codemod's self-test (`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test`): 169 cases in 11 batteries pass. Two batteries are new, each floor pinned at its case count:

1. **identity port, computed keys and exported names (fourth pass, #30020)**, 23 cases:
   - the moves prove, and two runs write byte-identical trees;
   - R1 rewrites each bare `this` (an object-literal method keeps its own) and adds the host's identity port under its docblock;
   - R3 reads a computed key over field names through the host and adds a setter for a key the body assigns through;
   - R4 imports an exported class from `engine.ts` and switches the header;
   - a key of any string or over a method name, and `this` in a type position, stay;
   - refusals: a staying name `engine.ts` does not export, a body that already reads `this.facade`, a class that declares `facade`;
   - failures: a `this.facade` the rewrite did not write, a site put back to a bare `this`, a factory that does not hand the engine, a port without its docblock, a header left saying "types only";
   - a leaf import a hand grew on one line reads as `line` and stays on one line when a move adds a name; the first pass's wrapped form reads as `wrap`; a statement in neither form reads as null.
2. **hand-series host slots (fifth pass, #30020)**, 17 cases:
   - the plan names the stub's one computing slot; the move proves; two runs write byte-identical trees;
   - the slot names its const, the hand module holds the arrow one level out under its docblock with the imports it reads, and `engine.ts` drops an import only the slot read;
   - failures: one edited character in the arrow, an edited docblock, an import binding nothing reads, an `engine.ts` that kept the slot's import, a head that moved nothing;
   - refusals: a slot that reads the stub's `this` or a local, a stub whose slots all forward, a slot holding a multi-line template, a method that is not a hand stub.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (one-time, run on the committed change, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

Each ablation went red, then `git checkout HEAD -- scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` and `git status --porcelain` came back empty:

- the members undo without the identity inverse;
- the identity port turned off (the real tree refuses `bare-this` again);
- `runStyles` with no `line` form (the `engine-security-resolvers.ts` move refuses at its import block, and the new one-line case goes red);
- the hand-slots undo with no re-indent.

</details>

## Verification

The final head merges `origin/main` `1b3e22f0`. `engine.ts` is unchanged between that `main` and the previous merge (`ae82d057`, after #30780 and #30800); `packages/objectql` moved (#30836's bare-name module, `registry.ts`). The moves were regenerated on `1b3e22f0` and compared with the head, not text-merged.

- Regeneration, with the two proofs chained: on a clean `1b3e22f0` tree, `--members bindHooks,resolveReadableIdsSecurity,buildHookApi,readMigrationFlagRowMemoized,recomputeSummaries,ownershipQueueService,createContext --write`, then `--members --verify --base origin/main` (exit 0: "7 moved method(s) …; engine.ts 11153 -> 10985 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte once the 6 import binding(s) only moved bodies read are pruned from the base"). That tree was recorded as a scratch commit; `--hand-slots serveReferenceNames --write`, then `--hand-slots --verify --base <that commit>` (exit 0: "1 moved (serveReferenceNames#formulaReadsReference); engine.ts 10985 -> 10977 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its hand modules byte-for-byte once the 1 import binding(s) only moved slots read are pruned from the base (formulaPlanEntry)"). The result equals the head's nine `packages/objectql/src` files byte for byte. The registry's delta against `main` is exactly the eight `#30020` rows removed, none added.
- Public `.d.ts` for `@objectstack/objectql`: built at base `1b3e22f0` and at head. With the shared chunk's hash normalised (`util-XXXXXXXX`), `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/core.d.ts` are byte-equal (sha256 `584d6d85…`, `c48657f3…` on both sides). The shared chunk goes from 10,030 to 9,947 lines: the 83 lines are the five private methods' docblocks, in five hunks, all deletions; no other line differs. Control: `SecurityResolversFacet.resolveReadableIdsSecurity` occurs 0 times in the base `dist/index.js` and once in the head's.
- After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` on the merged head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (including `check:test-typecheck`); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` 559 files, 11,200 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` all 14 artifacts up to date (with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: its `check:test-typecheck` runs out of heap at the default 2 GB here; this PR does not touch `packages/spec`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 74 families derived at head `923ebb82`; all 74 exit 0, including `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (every package's `dist/` was built this time). `--ran`: 74 derived, 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The codemod's and the facade gate's self-tests, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`, `pnpm check:adr-anchors` and eslint over the changed files are outside the derived set and were run separately, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rule A**, Elon's ruling on #30020 (2026-11-06 14:58Z, forwarded by the seat): the facade stays the one owner of state; hosts gain a `facade` port, and the codemod rewrites `this` to `this.facade` under the byte-exact undo. A facet declares and reaches the state it needs through its host. No field moves.
- **Series:** this is E1 of the design's §5 order. E2 (`find`, `findOne`) waits for this PR to land.
- **R7 is deferred to E6**, its only caller (`update`, which starts `engine-update.ts`). Shipping it here would leave a rule with no caller.
- **`.d.ts` is not byte-equal**: the five private methods' docblocks moved with their bodies (the first pass's docblock rule), so the shared declaration chunk loses those docblocks. No member line changes. The design's "byte-equal" expectation was too strong.
- Surface widened by the seat for this card: `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`. This PR touches no `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` and no `system-context.mdx` register.
